note: CLEF ROUTE UNAVAILABLE. Re-checked 2026-10-18 17:10 local. Every call still returns HTTP 400, but THE ERROR HAS CHANGED CHARACTER, and that matters for diagnosis. Earlier it was a schema rejection: the validator named required key names and then rejected those exact names, on every body shape including a text-only call with no audio. It is now code 7000 'No route for that URI' on clef, clef-omni and clef-flash, for audio and text bodies alike. That is a ROUTING-level failure, not a body-validation one -- the endpoint does not resolve at all for this account, so the original schema reading was probably a symptom rather than the fault. The account token is valid and @cf/pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v2 on the same account and the same request path returned 200 with is_complete=false, probability=0.3498 on a 1 s 200 Hz tone, so the path prefix and credentials are fine and the failure is specific to the clef routes. Still not worked around.
